write_vasp_input_files: write VASP input files for an ASE Atoms structure to a specified output directory
calculate_surface_k_points: calculate the k-point mesh for a surface calculation based on the unit cell size
clean_up_inputs: clean up ASE Atoms and VASP flags by enforcing the right-hand rule and setting k-points
run_vasp_relaxation: run a VASP relaxation calculation on an ASE Atoms object with custom VASP flags
setup_vasp_pseudopotentials: set up VASP pseudopotential paths and setups for an ASE Atoms structure
